translations.web: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
